MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The wired earbuds with a microphone felt relevant because I previously chose a wired headset with a mic; they could serve a similar listening and calling purpose if I needed a replacement.",
    "The USB external hard drive felt broadly relevant because my history includes practical computer connections and accessories, though I would only choose it when I needed backup capacity."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The smart speaker, streaming stick, and Bluetooth speaker introduce entertainment or voice-assistant uses that my past accessory purchases do not suggest I currently need.",
    "Buying a small-tablet mount does not mean I need another tablet or a TV wall mount; the device being supported and the intended use matter.",
    "The memory cards and drive case need a specific compatible device or carrying need to be useful, and I have no such need right now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in a few computer accessories seems to have been stretched into an interest in electronics generally.",
    "The list seems to favor widely chosen products, but their popularity does not give me a reason to buy them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My WiFi adapter, USB expansion card, display cable, and Ethernet adapter each solve a particular connection problem; that practical purpose matters more than simply being an electronic accessory.",
    "My purchases are spaced far apart, and even a relevant item needs a concrete replacement, compatibility, or capacity need before I would act."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my practical computer-accessory interests but extended them too broadly without a clear current need."
}
